title: 第88 章 平野县城来自haimeine的打赏加更第 87章 山间精怪
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 黑熊松开一只手，抡起蒲扇大的熊掌，一掌拍在蛇身上。
那一掌力道极沉，拍得蛇鳞碎裂。
青黑色的鳞片崩飞了好几片，露出底下惨白的蛇肉。
大蛇又是一声嘶鸣，绞缠的力道又紧了几分。
黑熊不管不顾，又是一掌。
第三掌落下时，大蛇的绞缠终于出现了一丝松动。
黑熊等的就是这一瞬。
它猛地低头，一口咬住了大蛇的七寸。
那满口黄牙如同铁钳般合拢，蛇血从齿缝间喷溅而出，溅了它满头满脸。
大蛇疯狂地挣扎，尾巴甩过来抽在黑熊背上，抽得皮毛翻开，血肉模糊。
黑熊挨了这一记，不但没有松口，反倒将蛇身踩在脚下。
它前掌按住蛇头，后腿蹬住地面，浑身肌肉绷紧，整个身体猛地后仰。
蛇身被拉成了一条直线。
随后，裂帛声起。
大蛇的身子从七寸处被硬生生撕成了两截。
上半截蛇身还在疯狂扭动，獠牙开合不止，血从断口处泉水般涌出，洒得满地都是。
下半截蛇身脱离了控制，在地上兀自翻滚弹跳，抽得碎石乱飞，过了好一阵才渐渐消停下来。
陆欢看得目瞪口呆。
她还没回过神来，便被接下来的一幕惊得捂住了嘴。
那黑熊将蛇尸踩在脚下，低下头，直接开始吃了起来。
它不急着将猎物彻底杀死，就那么踩着还在抽搐的蛇身，用爪子按住蛇头，一口一口地撕扯蛇身上的肉。
大蛇的嘴巴还在张合，獠牙徒劳地对着空气乱咬。
可它的脊椎已经断了，再也无力反击，只能眼睁睁地看着自己被一口一口吃掉。
这等吃法，实在太过残忍了些。
沈回见此情形，并未多言，只是站起身来，并指作诀。
白骸化作一道森寒的匹练，掠过山谷，绕着大蛇的头颈轻轻一转。
蛇头滚落在地，两排獠牙终于合上。
黑熊猛地抬起头来。
那只独眼死死盯着山脊上的沈回，口中还叼着一块撕下来的蛇肉。
沈回站在山脊上，与那只独眼对视了一息。
随后他伸手一招，白骸倒飞而回，稳稳落入掌中。
他没有再看那黑熊一眼。
随手掐了个剑诀，剑光一起，破空而去。
身后，那头独眼黑熊仰头望着那道远去的剑光，喉间的低吼逐渐平息。
content_en:
The black bear let go of one hand, picked up a paw as big as a cattail leaf fan, and slapped the snake with one palm.
The force of that palm was so heavy that it shattered the snake's scales.
Several blue-black scales fell apart, revealing the pale snake flesh underneath.
The big snake neighed again, and its twist became a little tighter.
The black bear ignored it and slapped him again.
When the third palm fell, the snake finally loosened its grip.
The black bear had been waiting for this moment.
It lowered its head suddenly and bit into seven inches of the big snake.
The yellow teeth in its mouth were closed like iron pincers, and snake blood spurted out from between the teeth, splashing all over its head and face.
The big snake struggled wildly, swung its tail and slapped the black bear on the back, causing the fur to open and the flesh to be bloody.
After the black bear received this blow, not only did it not let go, but it trampled the snake's body under its feet.
It pressed the snake's head with its front paws, pushed its hind legs on the ground, its muscles tightened, and its whole body leaned back suddenly.
The snake's body was stretched into a straight line.
Then, there was a sound of cracking silk.
The snake's body was torn into two pieces at seven inches.
The upper half of the snake's body was still twisting wildly, its fangs kept opening and closing, and blood gushed out from the broken part like a spring, sprinkling all over the floor.
The lower half of the snake's body was out of control, rolling and bouncing on the ground, sending gravel flying everywhere. It took a while before it gradually stopped.
Lu Huan was stunned.
Before she could recover, she was so shocked by the next scene that she covered her mouth.
The black bear trampled the snake carcass under its feet, lowered its head, and started eating.
It was not in a hurry to kill the prey completely. It just stepped on the still twitching snake body, pressed the snake's head with its claws, and tore the snake's flesh bit by bit.
The big snake's mouth was still opening and closing, its fangs biting the air in vain.
But its spine was broken and it could no longer fight back. It could only watch as it was eaten bit by bit.
This way of eating is really too cruel.
Seeing this situation, Shen Hui didn't say much, he just stood up and made some gestures.
The white skeleton turned into a cold streak, swept across the valley, and gently turned around the snake's head and neck.
The snake's head rolled to the ground, and the two rows of fangs finally closed.
The black bear suddenly raised his head.
The one eye was staring at Shen Hui on the ridge, with a piece of torn snake meat in its mouth.
Shen Hui stood on the ridge and looked at the one eye for a moment.
Then he stretched out his hand and made a move, and the white skeleton flew back and fell firmly into his palm.
He didn't look at the black bear again.
He casually made a sword move, and the sword light shot through the air together.
Behind him, the one-eyed black bear looked up at the retreating sword light, and the low growl in his throat gradually subsided.
